single_shot.rule: Describe scene, subject, chronological action, camera, dialogue and sound as cohesive prose.

multi_shot.rule: Write one chronological paragraph/short prose sequence. Name each edit transition naturally. Re-identify recurring subjects and state what visual/audio continuity carries across each cut. Do not output a numbered screenplay shot list as the final provider prompt.

image_to_video.rule: Continue directly from image_uri as literal frame 0; do not replay completed actions.

first_last_to_video.rule: Continue from image_uri and land naturally on last_frame_uri at the fixed known duration.

audio_to_video.rule: Treat audio_uri as the exact soundtrack/timing driver, not a soft voice reference. Synchronize cuts, speech and motion to it.

local_ic_lora.rule: Only bind raw image/video/audio references when the configured local IC-LoRA/custom workflow has been explicitly verified.

productionRules: Cloud LTX-2.5 supports T2V, I2V and A2V only; do not route 2.5 to Retake/Extend/Reframe endpoints.
Cloud generic character/product/place images are not a soft multi-reference bundle; prebake them into an approved first frame or use a verified local IC-LoRA workflow/fallback.
Automatic duration is T2V/I2V only and cannot be combined with last_frame_uri.
Audio-to-Video consumes one real soundtrack audio asset; arbitrary voice/music references must be precomposed/derived/fallback unless intentionally used as the exact soundtrack.
Use exact model-resolution-FPS-duration matrix validation before paid cloud submission.
